title: operator-provenance-attestation-and-residency-claim-reconciler
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds operator provenance attestation, reconciler for residency claims, and correlated audit indexes. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: production incidents exposed gaps in correlating operator sessions, RBAC decision traces, and KMS usage for tenancy-residency policy audits. This PR introduces an operator provenance attestation flow and a residency claim reconciler to increase fidelity of audit records and make RBAC v2 decision traces verifiable across services.

Summary of changes:
- Introduce operator provenance token (OPT) middleware: issues short-lived, signed attestations for operator sessions; persisted to authz-service for later verification.
- Extend RBAC v2 decision record to include 'provenance_token_id' and 'region_claim_hash' and wire through policy-evaluator output.
- Add residency-claim-reconciler service: periodic job that reconciles incoming requests' region assertions against KMS usage logs and tenant residency configuration; emits augmented audit events and corrective findings.
- Audit pipeline changes: new correlated_audit_index and cross_service_trace_id fields; indexer updated to deduplicate and join by provenance_token_id.
- KMS integration: tag KMS decrypt/encrypt calls with provenance_token_id when present and record minimal usage evidence to residency-claims bucket (encrypted).
- DB migration: create operator_provenance_tokens table (ttl-indexed) and residency_reconciler_jobs table.
- Tests: unit tests for middleware and reconciler logic, integration test with mini-kms simulator, e2e scenario validating a misrouted region claim is detected and produces an alert.
- Docs: design doc and operational runbook (runbook/reconciler-ops.md) explaining expected alert thresholds and mitigation steps.

- Action: fixed lint issues and added sync barrier in simulator (commit 9df0caa).
- Final run: all unit, integration, and e2e (canary) green.

Observability & SLOs:
- Added metrics: reconciler.run.latency, reconciler.findings.count{severity}, audit.join.skew_seconds.
- Added alert: reconciler.inconclusive_rate > 5% sustained 10m -> P2 for infra oncall.

Operational notes:
- The OPT signer keys are rotated with the same cadence as session-signing keys; ops playbook documents emergency key revocation.
- Reconciler runs as a single leader-elected job per region by default; flag --replica-count can be used for high-availability with distributed locks.

Security review:
- Security performed review of signer cryptography, OPT token fields limited to minimal claims, and KMS evidence writer uses envelope encryption to store minimal usage proofs.
- No new customer-facing API changes.

Migration/rollout plan:
- Step 1: deploy middleware behind feature flag and run reconciler in read-only mode (no findings) to verify joins.
- Step 2: enable findings emission to internal team only.
- Step 3: gradual rollout to all regions and enable alerts.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the OPT payload minimal (provenance_token_id reference, issuer, issued_at) to avoid PII in audit logs. The reconciler contains heuristics tuned to our current KMS evidence granularity; future work will extend proofs to multi-KMS provider environments. If you need to reproduce locally: run ./devtools/start-mini-kms && make test-integration --filter ReconcilerTests.
